about: Stills of the five 4D.OS worlds used by the playground landings. Each is a lossless WebP (cwebp -lossless -z 9) of a PNG capture of the live render, never retouched or re-dithered. All scenes are synthetic.

a.webp.capture: Live render of /a/ (pack cat-stairs), frame 300 playing; Chromium headless (Playwright) with SwiftShader, 1440×900 viewport cropped to 4:3 (1200×900, x=240); 2026-09-25
a.webp.method: Screenshot of the live render of /a/ (pack cat-stairs) playing at frame 300, Chromium headless (Playwright) with SwiftShader at 1440×900, cropped to 4:3 (1200×900 from x=240); converted to WebP with cwebp -lossless -z 9, not resized, retouched or re-dithered
